searchText: Hmmm it should work. I will recheck it 🙂 Do you have logs? Could you DM me? Hey <@425572898787426305> , I am updating a test where the client is getting a newPayload with a parent hash pointing to an unknown payload (`? <- P`)... Every single EL's behavior is to send me back a `SYNCING` and, according to the spec, `SYNCING` is only returned "if the payload extends the canonical chain", therefore they are all assuming something like `Head <- ? <- P` so to resolve this here, it seems like it wasn't a Nethermind issue, but a broader issue, and <@199561711278227457> fixed it apropos the kiln syncing

Every single EL's behavior is to send me back a `SYNCING` and, according to the spec, `SYNCING` is only returned "if the payload extends the canonical chain", therefore they are all assuming something like `Head <- ? <- P`
